prompts.concept:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design a gorgeous premium-quality three-screen iPhone app presentation for FoodJury's new "Lucky Court": playful retro American diner meets stern cartoon food court. Image 1 is the locked Judge Bite identity reference, image 2 is the approved app visual language. Preserve orange #FF6B35, navy #1A1A2E, mustard #FFD23F, warm cream #FFF8F0; bold condensed italic Bangers headings, friendly rounded Nunito body, chunky navy outlines, hard offset shadows, diner checker trim, hand-cut tickets, restrained stars. Strongly art-directed and tactile, not generic modern cards. All food is illustrated in the same digital cartoon style, never food photography. Design EXACTLY THREE full screens side by side on warm cream. All UI text crisp, readable, generous whitespace; no overlapping copy or buttons.
LEFT screen: orange masthead "LUCKY COURT" with checker trim, large headline "Same judge. New tricks.", a delightful large Judge Bite seriously balancing a spinning dinner plate, tilted small "ALWAYS OPEN" sticker, text "Your 3 free AI rulings are used. Lucky rulings are unlimited.", big mustard "LET LUCK DECIDE" button and subtle "Explore FoodJury Plus". No guilt or blocking.
CENTER screen: orange masthead "SPIN THE PLATE", subtitle "Four contenders. Equal chances.", very large cream dinner plate with four equally sized orange, mustard, cream, and soft green segments containing cartoon pizza, tacos, burger, salad. Navy pointer above. Judge Bite sternly watches from the lower right edge, but never obscures plate sectors. Tiny diner ticket showing actual option names below; large mustard "SPIN FOR DINNER" CTA. Layered physical plate rim, strong movement suggestion, delightful graphic food court.
RIGHT screen: orange masthead "THE LUCKY VERDICT", tilted "CASE CLOSED" stamp, huge "TACOS IT IS!", large illustrated tacos on a scalloped navy/mustard burst, celebrating Judge Bite beside a separate cream ruling ticket: "The wheel has spoken. Pass the salsa." label "Random pick · Spin the Plate", big mustard "SAVE THIS VERDICT" button, low prominence "Draw again". Keep bottom actions and ticket separate from artwork. Create a polished coherent system with purposeful large type, beautiful asymmetry and playful overlaps of background artwork only. No realism, no gradients, no glass, no gambling money/rewards. Closed-mouth judge faces or simple cream mouth, no double tongue.
prompts.plate: Use case: illustration-story. New transparent production illustration for FoodJury Lucky Court. Input image is REFERENCE for exact character identity and rendering. Judge Bite is an anthropomorphic oversized horizontal orange gavel head with cream ring at each end, two navy eyes and thick eyebrows, small navy judge robe with TWO cream collar tabs, cream cartoon gloves, rubber hose legs, navy shoes with cream soles. No human face, no wig, no separate handheld gavel. Pose: full body, one cream-gloved hand raised balancing a large tilted cream DINNER PLATE on one finger, the other hand planted sternly on hip. The plate has a navy double-rim with mustard inset, and is mostly blank, no food or lettering. Judge gives a witty skeptical one-eyebrow-up CLOSED-MOUTH expression as if taking random dinner selection very seriously. Dynamic confident lean, one heel raised, silhouette clean, proportions consistent with reference. Retro 1930s rubber hose cartoon meets contemporary crisp polished digital illustration, orange/navy/cream/mustard palette, thick navy outlines, subtle reference-style shading. True transparent background. Keep entire plate, full gavel head, both shoes and both hands within frame with generous breathing room. No text, no UI, no shadow background, no extra limbs, no red tongue, no photorealism.
prompts.ticket: Use case: illustration-story. New transparent production illustration for FoodJury's random order-ticket draw. Input image is REFERENCE for exact Judge Bite character identity, materials and rendering. Oversized horizontal orange gavel head with cream end bands, two navy eyes and thick eyebrows, navy short judge robe with TWO cream collar tabs, cream gloves, rubber hose limbs, navy shoes with cream soles. Full body Judge Bite stands behind and slightly to the right of a small open orange diner order-ticket box on a short cream counter ledge; one glove holds up a single long BLANK cream tear-off order ticket with navy border and mustard top strip, other glove rests on box. Three other blank ticket corners peek from box, not confetti. Stern delighted "I have the ruling" expression: one eyebrow arched, confident tiny closed-mouth smile. Ticket is clear and prominent enough for app to overlay live option text later but do not put text in the image. Box front has simple navy/cream checker strip. Dynamic pose but clean silhouette. Match reference thick navy outlines, polished digital cartoon, mild flat shading, not 3D. True transparent background, whole head and shoes and props visible with margin. No text, numbers, extra limbs, extra gavel, human hair, red tongue, food photography, shadow rectangle.
